boundary: Typed pointer reading of ONE focus world as a small directed graph, on one teaching order. The held-back questions are about five course worlds the machine never read (same world sizes and question kinds as training); the development panel is out-of-distribution ten-node parts/reach. The primary label is keyed on the RELATIONAL tier, so gains on the DIRECT_READ kinds alone cannot produce it. No protected final-study, general CAS architecture, or full-machine claim.
comparison_method: the practice value was recorded by the practice study's own process, with no checkpoint check and a different RNG history; `_framework` re-seeds all three streams, so this build is a pure function of the seed and this equality IS the comparison

identical_start_with_and_without_the_che.off_arm: the practice study's recorded identity, obtained by a process that ran NO checkpoint check and had a wholly different RNG history -- which is why this comparison IS the with-versus-without comparison
identical_start_with_and_without_the_che.on_arm: this job's container, built after phase A returned, whose `^6` start `core_identity` records
identical_start_with_and_without_the_che.reason: R1-2. This flag is DEFINITIONALLY the same comparison as `core_identity_equals_the_practice_start` above -- the same two values, the same operator -- so it can never vary independently of it and is NOT separate evidence. It is kept, and kept honest, because the gate reader (`records/typed_pointer_001/evaluate_gates.py`, `DG4_FLAGS` and `I3:<seed>:DG4_CHECK_INDEPENDENT_START`) looks for it by name.
identical_start_with_and_without_the_che.why_there_is_no_independent_measurement_: a second arm cannot be built. An arm built BEFORE phase A would start from the RNG state phase A overwrites (`learner.py:358-362`), which is the defect the phase order exists to avoid, and the phase order is load-bearing (`pre_design/AWS_SMOKE_S10_PLAN.md:155`, review M3). Perturbing this job's own RNG to build a third arm would change the numerics of the model that trains, on a spend path, for a field that is already covered.

local_note: a LOCAL build reproduces the practice weights to within 7.450580596923828e-09 but not byte-exactly, so this equality is an IN-JOB AWS check only
phase_a_finished_before_the_model_was_se: MEASURED, not asserted (R1-2). True only when all three measured readings agree: no pointer model was attached to this run before this build, phase A had already returned at an earlier reading of the run's own monotonic clock, and phase A's own recorded status is COMPLETE. A phase A that ran and FAILED leaves this false, because the reference identity was then read from the practice sidecar directly and it is not phase A's evidence that the start was compared against.
